# Reshape the data to have one row per country and year
gdp_data_melted = gdp_data.melt(id_vars=['Country Group', 'Country Code', 'Series Name', 'Series Code'], 
                                 var_name='Year', 
                                 value_name='GNI_per_capita')

education_expenditure_data_melted = education_expenditure_data.melt(id_vars=['Country Group', 'Country Code', 'Series Name', 'Series Code'], 
                                                                    var_name='Year', 
                                                                    value_name='Education_Expenditure')

# Merge the two datasets on 'Country Group', 'Country Code', and 'Year'
merged_data = pd.merge(gdp_data_melted, education_expenditure_data_melted, 
                       on=['Country Group', 'Country Code', 'Year'])

# Display the first few rows of the merged dataset
merged_data.head()
